"import json
import numpy as np

import openmdao.api as om
import pycycle.api as pyc
from pycycle import map_data


class Turbojet(pyc.Elements):
    def setup(self):
        thermo_data = pyc.AIR_JETA_TAB_SPEC

        self.add_subsystem('fc', pyc.FlightCondition())
        self.add_subsystem('flow_start', pyc.FlowStart(thermo_data=thermo_data))
        self.add_subsystem('inlet', pyc.Inlet(thermo_data=thermo_data))
        self.add_subsystem('comp', pyc.Compressor(thermo_data=thermo_data,
                                                  map_data=map_data.AXI5()))
        self.add_subsystem('burn', pyc.Combustor(thermo_data=thermo_data))
        self.add_subsystem('trb', pyc.Turbine(thermo_data=thermo_data,
                                              map_data=map_data.LPT2269()))
        self.add_subsystem('noz', pyc.Nozzle(thermo_data=thermo_data,
                                             nozzle_type='CD', loss_coeff=0.99))
        self.add_subsystem('shaft', pyc.Shaft())

        # flow connections
        self.connect('flow_start.Fl_O', 'fc.Fl_I')
        self.pyc_connect_flow('fc.Fl_O', 'inlet.Fl_I')
        self.pyc_connect_flow('inlet.Fl_O', 'comp.Fl_I')
        self.pyc_connect_flow('comp.Fl_O', 'burn.Fl_I')
        self.pyc_connect_flow('burn.Fl_O', 'trb.Fl_I')
        self.pyc_connect_flow('trb.Fl_O', 'noz.Fl_I')

        # ambient pressure for nozzle gross thrust computation
        self.connect('fc.Ps', 'noz.Ps')

        # shaft connections
        self.connect('comp.trq', 'shaft.trq_1')
        self.connect('trb.trq', 'shaft.trq_2')
        self.connect('shaft.Nmech', 'comp.Nmech')
        self.connect('shaft.Nmech', 'trb.Nmech')

        # balances: W (Fn target), fuel_frac (T4 target), trb PR (power balance)
        bal = self.add_subsystem('bal', om.BalanceComp(
            name='W', units='lbm/s', eq_name='eq_W', rhs_name='Fn_target', lhs_name='Fn', val=100.0))
        bal.add_balance('fuel_frac', eq_name='eq_T4', rhs_name='T4_target',
                        lhs_name='T4', val=0.02, lower=1e-6, upper=0.2)
        bal.add_balance('trb_PR', eq_name='eq_PWR', rhs_val=0.0,
                        lhs_name='power_err', val=3.0, lower=1.01, upper=10.0)

        self.connect('flow_start.W', 'bal.lhs:W') if hasattr(bal, 'lhs') else None
        self.connect('bal.W', 'flow_start.W')
        self.connect('noz.FG', 'bal.lhs:W')

        self.connect('burn.Fl_I:FuelFrac:Wfuel', 'bal.lhs:fuel_frac') if False else None
        self.connect('bal.fuel_frac', 'burn.FuelFrac')
        self.connect('burn.Fl_O:tot:T', 'bal.lhs:T4')

        self.connect('bal.trb_PR', 'trb.PR')

        self.add_subsystem('pwr', om.ExecComp('err=cp-trb', cp=0.0, trb=0.0, units=None))
        self.connect('comp.power', 'pwr.cp')
        self.connect('trb.power', 'pwr.trb')
        self.connect('pwr.err', 'bal.lhs:power_err')

        # net thrust / TSFC bookkeeping
        self.add_subsystem('thrust', om.ExecComp('Fn=FG-Wair*V0', Fn=0., FG=0., Wair=0., V0=0., units='lbf'))
        self.connect('noz.FG', 'thrust.FG')
        self.connect('flow_start.W', 'thrust.Wair')
        self.connect('fc.V0', 'thrust.V0')

        self.add_subsystem('sfc', om.ExecComp('TSFC=Wfuel/Fn', TSFC=0., Wfuel=0., Fn=14500.))
        self.connect('burn.Wfuel', 'sfc.Wfuel')
        self.connect('thrust.Fn', 'sfc.Fn')


def main():
    p = om.Problem(model=Turbojet())
    p.model.nonlinear_solver = om.NewtonSolver(solve_subsystems=True, maxiter=50,
                                               atol=1e-8, rtol=1e-8)
    p.model.nonlinear_solver.linesearch = om.BoundsEnforceLS()
    p.model.linear_solver = om.DirectSolver(assemble_jac=False)

    p.setup(force_alloc_complex=False, derivatives=False)

    # design point: sea level static
    p.set_val('fc.alt', 0.0, units='ft')
    p.set_val('fc.MN', 0.001)

    p.set_val('inlet.MN', 0.6)
    p.set_val('inlet.loss_coeff', 0.0)

    p.set_val('comp.PR', 12.5)
    p.set_val('comp.eff', 0.85)
    p.set_val('comp.MN', 0.5)"
